bridge.config.foreign_entry: {path} already has a `{key}` entry that is not the bridge; it is left alone unless explicitly asked
bridge.config.invalid_json: {path} is not valid JSON; it is not rewritten
bridge.config.not_object: {path} does not have the expected shape (an object with `mcpServers`); it is not rewritten
bridge.error.daemon_down: could not reach the local-delegate daemon at {url} ({detail}). Is it running? Check with `local-delegate doctor`
bridge.error.http_status: the local-delegate daemon answered HTTP {status} at {url}: {detail}
bridge.error.no_answer: the local-delegate daemon closed the connection without answering (did it restart?); try again
bridge.error.session_lost: the local-delegate daemon forgot the session and it could not be rebuilt; restart the server in Claude Desktop
bridge.error.token_rejected: the local-delegate daemon rejected the token (HTTP 401). The bridge reads it from the Windows user variable `{variable}`: check that it exists and matches the one the daemon uses
bridge.log.session_recovered: the local-delegate daemon forgot the session (did it restart?); rebuilt
bridge.log.token_absent: not found; if the daemon requires one it will answer 401
